g:HTMLPanel.p: Dialogs on top of the page: Modal, with a header, body and footer.

d:Example.heading: Basic
d:Example.description: A button with `dataToggle="MODAL"` and a `dataTarget` opens the modal; `title` and `closable` fill its header, and `dataDismiss="MODAL"` closes it.

d:Example.heading: Options
d:Example.description: `centered` centers the dialog vertically, `scrollable` scrolls the body instead of the page, `size` and `fullscreen` change its size, and `dataBackdrop="STATIC"` keeps it open on outside clicks.

d:Example.heading: From Java
d:Example.description: `show()` and `hide()` open and close the modal; `addShownHandler` and `addHiddenHandler` run when it has opened or closed.
